newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Four Corners coal-fired unit seen up Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Four Corners coal-fired unit seen up Tuesday.

text.p: The 750-megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in Arizona should be back to full power by the end of the day, a spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co, the plant's operator, said Tuesday.
The unit was shut Friday night due to accumulation of ash in part of its boiler.
The plant's other units, another with a 750-MW capacity, two at 175 MW and one at 200 MW, were operating at normal rates, the spokesman said.
APS, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, has a 15 percent stake in Four Corners' units 4 and 5, while Edison International's Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake.
